data.narrative:
Flock Safety, a Series G-stage Defense & Security company, carries a current post-money valuation of $7.5B following $1.4B+ in total capital raised. The valuation assessment references a peer universe of 10 same-sector companies at comparable valuation tiers, spanning 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Shield AI ($12.7B, Series G), Helsing ($18.0B, Series D), and Saronic ($9.2B, Series D).

Two triangulation methods apply to this analysis. Stage-progression modeling, anchored to the $7.5B last post-money and applying a standard 1.25x Series G step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $9.4B. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company Defense & Security cohort yields a median valuation of $4.5B, with a range of $2.1B to $18.0B. The dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage and commercial maturity within the peer set.

These methods triangulate to a range of $3.8B (low) to $10.8B (high), with a median implied value of $6.9B. The current $7.5B valuation sits within this range but above the peer median, suggesting a premium relative to same-sector peers or expectations of near-term step-up momentum. Key uncertainties include comparability of peer growth trajectories and the timing of capital deployment relative to comparable funding events.
